items.title: 3 Cash ETFs Investors Are Turning To As Higher Rates Keep Biting
items.summary: AI highfliers are suddenly back on the ground, volatility is spiking and the Federal Reserve is still talking tough on rates, so parking capital safely has become a lot more interesting. Cash is no longer just an afterthought. It is a tool. This article walks through 3 ETFs from a money market and ultra short Treasury screener that look well placed in the current storm and explains how each reacts to the AI unwind and higher for longer rates. The three ETFs in this article are only a starter...

items.title: She Retired From Teaching In 2001 With $725,000. Two Bear Markets In Eight Years Took Nearly Half Of Her Portfolio, And She Had To Go Back To The Classroom. Here’s What Every Retiree Needs To Know About Sequence Of Returns Risk
items.summary: Sharon walked out of her classroom for the last time just as the market began to slide, then watched a second crash arrive years later. Her story reveals why timing can matter more than returns, and what a small reserve might have changed.

items.title: Schwab's Aguilar on ETF Growth, Privates and Prediction Markets
items.summary: Schwab Asset Management CEO & CIO Omar Aguilar joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Aguilar discusses Schwab's growth in ETFs, how investors are using low-cost products to diversify portfolios, the firm's approach to prediction markets and expanding retail access to private companies.
